name: ios-app
title: iOS app
summary: Screens that look right in light, in dark and with VoiceOver.

rules.text: Every screen has a light and a dark screenshot test.
rules.why: a screen that reads well in one mode can be unreadable in the other.

rules.text: No change removes a VoiceOver label from a screen.
rules.why: a missing label makes a control invisible to someone who cannot see the screen.
